entries.heading: There is hereby appropriated $1,996,000 to carry out
ancestors: DIVISION B—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2019
entries.text:
Sec. 741.  There is hereby appropriated $1,996,000 to carry out 
section 1621 of Public Law 110-246.

entries.heading: None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made
ancestors: DIVISION D—FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2019
entries.text:
Sec. 741.  None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made 
available by this or any other Act may be used to begin or announce a 
study or public-private competition regarding the conversion to 
contractor performance of any function performed by Federal employees 
pursuant to Office of Management and Budget Circular A-76 or any other 
administrative regulation, directive, or policy.
